caption:
Most shops don't lose leads to bad marketing.

They lose them to sticky notes, text threads, and a memory that maxes out by lunch.

Black Arrow OS fixes that for free. Log three things per lead: name, source, next step. That's the whole system.

No signup. No card. Open it on your phone between jobs and know exactly who still needs a callback.
